name: Jev
_comment: Jev returns typed judgments, not text. The adapter in src/models/jev.js reads the structured world snapshot ($WORLD_JSON) and the command docs from this prompt, asks Jev for the player's intent and the arguments a request leaves vague, and formats the !command(args) line itself, so no prose is ever generated. Values the request names outright are read in code; crafting is planned in code from the recipe registry. Embeddings are unavailable, so example selection falls back to word overlap; commands needing free text (!newAction, !goal, !searchWiki, ...) are withheld. See JEV.md.
